title: helianthemum nummularium subsp. glabrum
intro: Helianthemum nummularium subsp. glabrum, commonly known as Rockrose or Irish Rose, is a plant species belonging to the family Cistaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Helianthemum nummularium subsp. glabrum include wound healing, antiseptic, and antipyretic actions, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
